entries.title: Membership Types & Pricing
entries.content:
Facility memberships (from tucsonymca.org/membership-types/):
- Family (2 adults + dependents under 24): $80/month, drops to $70/month after 12 months
- Single Parent Family (1 adult + dependents under 24): $65/month, drops to $55/month after 12 months
- Adult (24+): $50/month, drops to $40/month after 12 months
- Young Adult (18–23): $25/month, drops to $20/month after 12 months
- Youth (under 18): $15/month
All facility memberships include facility access and program registration. Kids under 12 are not allowed in the facility unsupervised.

Program-only memberships (no facility access):
- Program Membership: $25/year
- Family Program Membership: $50/year

Specialized:
- Military: discounted rates by pay grade; enrollment fee waived for veterans
- Tucson Police Department: first 2 months free, then 20% off; joining fee waived
- 7-Day Trial: free trial membership available
- Medicare members: accepted through SilverSneakers, RenewActive/OnePass, and Silver&Fit

No contracts, no large upfront fees, no annual fees. Membership includes YMCA360 digital access at no extra cost.

Source: tucsonymca.org/membership-types/ and tucsonymca.org/membership/ — confirm current pricing with a manager before quoting a member, since rates can change.

entries.title: Financial Assistance / Scholarships
entries.content:
YMCA of Southern Arizona offers financial assistance so cost isn't a barrier to membership or programs. Open to any individual or family regardless of ability to pay full price.

Covers: memberships (except youth/young adult), sports leagues, summer day camps, school-out programs, and Triangle Y overnight camp. Awards last one year and work at all YMCA of Southern Arizona locations.

Recipients are asked to contribute some portion of the fee — the Y's philosophy is that people benefit from contributing to their own membership cost. Assistance is tiered (Tiers A, B, C) with different subsidy levels ($5–$100 depending on the program).

How to apply:
- Online at tucsonymca.ymcamso.org/new/
- In person with a paper application (available in English and Spanish)

No specific income cutoffs or required documents are listed on the website — refer members to the front desk or membership director for the current application and guidelines.

Source: tucsonymca.org/financial-assistance/

entries.title: How to Join / General Membership Info
entries.content:
Joining is online through the Y's registration system (Register / Join Today buttons on tucsonymca.org lead to operations.daxko.com) or in person at any branch. No contracts, no large upfront fees, no annual fees.

Membership includes YMCA360 (the Y's on-demand/digital fitness platform) at no extra cost, described by the Y as "two for the price of one" — in-person plus digital access.

A free 7-day trial membership is available for people who want to try the Y before joining.

Source: tucsonymca.org/membership/ and tucsonymca.org/membership-types/

entries.title: Guest Passes & Day Passes
entries.content:
Guest passes: members get 6 free guest passes per year. A guest under 18 needs a parent on-site to sign the waiver before they can come as a guest. Guests are limited to 2 visits total before we ask them to join as a member. The guest must bring ID, and the member must come with their guest each time (guests can't come alone on a member's pass).

Day passes (non-members): $10 for an individual, $20 for a family. Day passes are non-refundable.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Membership Holds & Cancellations
entries.content:
Members can make changes — holds, cancellations, updates — at the front desk, online at tucsonymca.org/contact-us/, or by emailing businessoffice@tucsonymca.org.

Holds: up to 3 months.
Cancellations: require 30 days' notice.
Staff have discretion to adjust these (hold length or notice period) case by case if they see fit.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Learn & Play (Kids' Area)
entries.content:
Learn & Play is a benefit of Family and Single Parent Family memberships (not included with individual/adult-only memberships).

Kids can be in Learn & Play up to 2 hours a day during its open hours. They must stay on-site the whole time — parents can't leave the building. Staff will come get the parent if the child needs them. Parents must check kids in and out with Learn & Play staff.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Pool & Aquatics
entries.content:
Pool hours are posted on the YMCA360 app and on the website — check there for the current schedule (hours can vary by day/location).

Included in membership: lap swim, open swim, and aqua fitness classes.
Extra cost, registration required: group and private swim lessons.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Group Exercise Class Reservations
entries.content:
Members reserve a spot in a group exercise class through the YMCA360 app, opening 50 hours before the class start time. Spots are limited — only members with a reservation can attend.

Classes have waitlists. If a spot opens up (someone doesn't show), waitlisted members present at class start can take the open spot.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Personal Training & EGYM
entries.content:
Equipment orientation is free. Members request it at tucsonymca.org/personal-training/ — once requested, our staff reach out to schedule the orientation (or Personal Training sessions if they want ongoing training).

EGYM: after a member purchases an EGYM orientation, staff get a notification and follow up to schedule it. After completing EGYM orientation, using the EGYM equipment requires a $10/month subscription.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Holiday Hours
entries.content:
Holiday hours (closures/adjusted hours for Thanksgiving, Christmas, July 4th, etc.) are kept in this spreadsheet — check it for the current schedule: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19agFLR0D5BSrA6COCvG6fPoRO927nq60cvgb6g1iHVM/edit?usp=sharing

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Payment Methods
entries.content:
Monthly membership dues: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express, or bank draft (EFT) only. We do not take cash for a monthly draft — a draft method is required for monthly membership.

Annual membership: cash, check, card, or EFT are all accepted.

Insurance-based members (e.g. SilverSneakers-type memberships) should still have a billing method on file, for donations or EGYM subscriptions.

Programs: payment is due at the time of registration, and most programs are online-registration only.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Youth Equipment & Supervision Ages
entries.content:
Ages 8–11: must have a guardian listed on the account supervising them at all times.

Ages 12–15: can be in any area unsupervised, but may not use the free weight area, and may be limited to certain cardio and strength machines. They should see a personal trainer for an orientation.

Ages 16 and up: no equipment restrictions.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Facility Rentals & Private Events
entries.content:
Send any rental request to the Executive Director. Renting requires a signed Facility Use Agreement, plus (per that agreement): proof of commercial general liability insurance ($1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate, plus $1,000,000 Sexual Abuse & Molestation coverage) naming YMCA of Southern Arizona as additional insured, criminal background checks and a sex offender registry check on the renting group's staff, and a signed Third-Party Child Protection Code of Conduct. Registered sex offenders are not permitted on YMCA property.

Rentable spaces include the pool, gymnasium, teen center, meeting rooms, and the group cycling room — priced per hour or flat rate depending on the space; get current rates from the Executive Director, they aren't fixed. If the pool is part of the rental, YMCA lifeguards are required and pool use adds fees. Other possible add-on fees: a YMCA staff monitor for the space, a cleanup fee (minimum $25/hour) if YMCA staff has to clean up after the event, and cost of repair for any damage. A damage deposit is collected and refunded within 30 days after the rental, minus anything needed for damage/cleanup.

Both forms (Facility Use Agreement and the Third-Party Code of Conduct) are available at tucsonymca.org/Staff-resources/ (password: SAZSTAFF) — the Facility Use Agreement is also attached here as a flyer.

Source: front desk / RJ + YSAZ Facility Use Agreement, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Summer Camp & Triangle Y Ranch Camp Registration
entries.content:
Summer camp registration is done online. Any summer camp questions go to youthassist@tucsonymca.org.

Triangle Y Ranch (overnight camp) registration is also done online, through https://operations.daxko.com/online/5242/Security/login.mvc/find_account. Overnight camp questions go to overnight@tucsonymca.org.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Before & After School Care
entries.content:
Before and after school care is handled through online registration. Any questions go to youthassist@tucsonymca.org.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Check-In Requirements
entries.content:
All members and guests must check in at the front desk. We don't issue physical membership cards — members check in with the barcode in the YMCA360 app.

When registering someone, ask for a state ID. Because we run background checks, make sure the account has the member's legal name and a clear photo of their face — no shadows, hats, or dark glasses.

Members can update their photo on file whenever they want, or at staff's request.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Program Registration & Department Contacts
entries.content:
All adult and youth programs register online. Route questions by department:
- Sports/youth program questions: sports@tucsonymca.org
- Aquatics questions: aquatics@tucsonymca.org
- Youth development questions (summer camp, before/after school, Triangle Y Ranch camp): youthassist@tucsonymca.org

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Member Support Escalation
entries.content:
If the front desk and the Executive Director can't resolve a member's question or issue, escalate it to support@tucsonymca.org.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Sauna, Steam Room & Hot Tub
entries.content:
None of our branches have a sauna, steam room, or hot tub.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Towels, Lockers & Lost Property
entries.content:
Towel service: Lohse YMCA is the only branch that offers towel service — no other locations have it.

Lockers: monthly locker rentals are available — check with your Executive Director for that location's process. Day-use lockers are available; members need to bring their own lock.

Locks left on overnight: subject to removal. Left items are bagged, labeled, and held for 30 days, then donated to a local nonprofit if unclaimed.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Adding/Removing Members & Billing Updates
entries.content:
Any account changes — adding or removing a family member on a membership, updating billing info — can be done at the front desk, through the Contact Us page (tucsonymca.org/contact-us/), or by emailing businessoffice@tucsonymca.org.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Failed Draft Payments
entries.content:
If a member's monthly draft fails, our staff team reaches out over the next few weeks to collect payment. If payment isn't received before the next scheduled draft date, the membership is canceled.

Any balance still owed stays on the account as an alert, and the member's online access may be blocked.

We do charge a return fee for a failed draft (the fee varies).

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Lost Key Tag & EGYM Wristband Fees
entries.content:
There's no fee for a lost or forgotten key tag.

A lost EGYM wristband has a $15 replacement fee.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Employer & Corporate Discount Groups
entries.content:
We offer a variety of employer discount groups. When signing someone up for a membership, check whether their employer is a listed discount group and select it during signup.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Donations Received at the Front Desk
entries.content:
Any donation the front desk receives should be given to the Executive Director for processing.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Volunteering
entries.content:
Anyone interested in volunteering can email info@tucsonymca.org with their information.

For volunteering specifically within sports, email sports@tucsonymca.org instead.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Incident Reports & 911 Calls
entries.content:
For any incident, staff should fill out an incident report and submit it to their supervisor for final review.

If 911 is called for any reason, staff must also send an email report to the Executive Director, RJB@tucsonymca.org, and CathyS@tucsonymca.org. The incident report itself should be left for the ED to review.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Weather & Lightning Closures
entries.content:
The pool can close due to lightning. When lightning is detected within 6 miles, all outdoor areas are closed (basketball, bocce ball, TRX, and the pool) for a minimum of 30 minutes. If another lightning strike occurs during that window, the 30-minute clock restarts. Once 30 minutes pass without a strike, outdoor facilities reopen. Aquatics staff take the lead on monitoring and keep the front desk, Executive Director, fitness staff, and others updated.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Refunds — Program
entries.content:
Directors and Program Leads can offer a refund or credit. Some programs have the participant acknowledge that program's specific refund guidelines at signup.

All refund requests should be sent to the business office at businessoffice@tucsonymca.org, including the program lead/director if they haven't already submitted it — the business office will want their approval.

However, if a member on the account is participating in a program, they need to maintain an active membership through the length of the program.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Refund: Membership
entries.content:
We offer a 30-day refund for any membership — if a member cancels within the first 30 days, they can receive a full refund.

If a member requests a refund for a past month for any reason, listen to the member and either process the refund or pass it along to the Executive Director or Membership Lead. All cancellation requests should be sent to the business office — they add notes and indicate when the last draft date will be.

However, if a member on the account is participating in a program, they need to maintain an active membership through the length of the program.

Source: front desk / RJ, Sept 2026.
